shortDescription: By Rodrigo Viga GaierChinese automaker Jetour, part of the Chery group HKEX:9973, has reached an agreement with the Rio de Janeiro state government to produce vehicles locally, two state government sources told Reuters on Tuesday.

children: Chinese automaker Jetour, part of the Chery group
, has reached an agreement with the Rio de Janeiro state government to produce vehicles locally, two state government sources told Reuters on Tuesday.
The agreement is for production at Jaguar Land Rover's (JLR) plant in the city of Itatiaia, the sources said
The terms of the deal were not immediately clear
Jetour announced in March the start of operations in Brazil, and has stated its intentions to produce locally
An executive said in August that the firm was evaluating options such as sharing idle capacity at facilities owned by automaker groups already established in Brazil
Rio de Janeiro state government said it remains in discussions with firms interested in the Itatiaia plant, while JLR and Jetour did not immediately reply to a request for comment
Jetour, which has focused its Brazilian launches on hybrid vehicles, has sold 7,640 units in the country through October this year, data from dealers' association Fenabrave showed
